textes.Bienvenue chez Popote & Pistons, une flo: Welcome to Popote & Pistons, a fleet of two food trucks and a cargo trike. Trucks, locations, stops, dishes, sales, stockouts and loyalty cards: all its data is here. You help its team: Octave, the founder, Prune, the head chef, Killian on scheduling, Nolwenn on stock and Léonie at the till and on loyalty. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par véhicule de la flotte : de: One row per vehicle in the fleet: two trucks and a cargo trike, each with its name, its type and its specialty.
textes.Une ligne par emplacement où un véhicule: One row per location where a vehicle can set up: its name, its type, its daily fee and whether it has a power outlet. A location may have had no stops.
textes.Une ligne par sortie au planning : véhic: One row per stop on the schedule: vehicle, location, date, hours, status and weather. In the fortnight from October 6 to 19, 2025, each stop is done or cancelled; the later ones are planned. Only the stops that are done have sales.
textes.Une ligne par plat à la carte d’un véhic: One row per item on a vehicle’s menu, sides, desserts and drinks included: its category, its price and whether it’s vegetarian. Each vehicle has its own menu; an item may never have been sold.
textes.Une ligne par client qui a une carte de: One row per customer who has a loyalty card, whether or not they came during the fortnight: first name, last name, email, the date their card was created and their stamps. Customers without a card aren’t in it.
textes.Une ligne par vente, c’est-à-dire une co: One row per sale, meaning an order placed at the counter during a stop: its order and handover times, its payment method and its amount. Its items (at least one) are in the sale_items table.
textes.Une ligne par plat d’une vente, avec son: One row per item in a sale, with its number of portions. A sale’s amount is the sum of its rows: quantity × price of the item.
textes.Une ligne par rupture de stock : un plat: One row per stockout: an item that ran out during a stop, and the time it did. After that time, the item isn’t sold anymore until the end of the stop.
textes.Nom du véhicule, peint sur sa carrosseri: Name of the vehicle, painted on its body: “La Bielle”, “La Soupape” or “Le Carbu”.
textes.Type de véhicule : « Camion » ou « Tripo: Vehicle type: “Truck” or “Cargo trike” (a small three-wheeled electric utility vehicle).
textes.Ce que sert le véhicule : « Burgers », «: What the vehicle serves: “Burgers”, “Galettes and crêpes” or “Coffee and sweets”.
textes.Nom de l’emplacement (ex. « Parvis de la: Name of the location (e.g. “Station Forecourt”, “Chestnut Festival”).
textes.Redevance d’une journée sur place, par v: Fee for one day on site, per vehicle, in euros; it’s only paid for a stop that is done. 0 for a free location; empty (NULL) if it isn’t set yet.
textes.1 si l’emplacement a une borne électriqu: 1 if the location has a power outlet to plug the vehicle into, 0 otherwise (then the generator has to run).
The location where it sets up.
textes.Date de la sortie, au format AAAA-MM-JJ: Date of the stop, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. “2025-10-06”).
textes.Heure d’ouverture du service au public,: Time service opens to the public, in HH:MM format (e.g. “07:00”).
textes.Heure de fermeture du service, au format: Time service closes, in HH:MM format.
textes.Statut de la sortie : « Effectuée », « A: Status of the stop: “Done”, “Cancelled” or “Planned” (on the schedule, not done yet).
textes.Météo relevée pendant la sortie : « Sole: Weather recorded during the stop: “Sun”, “Clouds” or “Rain”; empty (NULL) for a cancelled or planned stop.
textes.Nom du plat (ex. « Burger classique », «: Name of the item (e.g. “Classic burger”, “Cannelé”). Two vehicles can offer an item with the same name, each with its own ID.
The vehicle that has this item on its menu.
Price of one portion, in euros.
textes.1 si le plat est végétarien (sans viande: 1 if the item is vegetarian (no meat or fish), 0 otherwise.
textes.Adresse e-mail du client ; vide (NULL) s: Customer’s email address; empty (NULL) if they didn’t give one. Two customers never have the same one.
textes.Date de création de sa carte de fidélité: Date their loyalty card was created, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Nombre de tampons sur la carte en ce mom: Number of stamps on the card right now, from 0 to 9: each sale made with the card adds one; at the 10th, the customer gets a free item and the card goes back to 0.
textes.La sortie pendant laquelle la vente a eu: The stop during which the sale took place.
textes.Le client qui a présenté sa carte de fid: The customer who showed their loyalty card; empty (NULL) for a customer without a card.
textes.Heure de la commande au comptoir, au for: Time of the order at the counter, in HH:MM format (e.g. “12:05”).
textes.Heure à laquelle la commande a été remis: Time the order was handed to the customer, in HH:MM format; empty (NULL) if the crew member didn’t record it.
textes.Montant payé, en euros : la somme des li: Amount paid, in euros: the sum of the sale’s rows (quantity × price of the item).
The sale the row belongs to.
textes.Nombre de portions de ce plat dans la ve: Number of portions of this item in the sale.
textes.La sortie pendant laquelle le plat a man: The stop during which the item ran out.
textes.Heure à laquelle le plat a été épuisé, a: Time the item ran out, in HH:MM format.
textes.Quels emplacements n’ont pas de borne él: Which locations have no power outlet?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks, trucks fitted out as kitchens, and a cargo trike, a small three-wheeled electric utility vehicle. Every day, the vehicles set up at various locations, from the station to the market. Some locations have a power outlet to plug the vehicle into, others don’t. Killian, who schedules the stops, then takes the generator along. To know in advance where to bring it, he wants the list of locations without an outlet, with their type.
textes.les emplacements sans borne électrique: the locations without a power outlet
textes.La présence d’une borne est notée 1 pour: Whether there’s an outlet is recorded as 1 for yes and 0 for no. A single condition is enough, on the value 0.
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each vehicle has its own menu: burgers for La Bielle, galettes and crêpes for La Soupape, coffee and sweets for Le Carbu. Each menu mixes main dishes, sides, desserts and drinks; some are vegetarian, others aren’t. Prune, the head chef, is preparing a “Vegetarian” poster shared by the three vehicles. She only puts the main dishes on it, with their price and the vehicle that serves them.
textes.le nom du véhicule qui le propose: the name of the vehicle that offers it
textes.les plats végétariens de la catégorie «: the vegetarian items in the category “Main”
textes.par prix, du moins cher au plus cher, pu: by price, cheapest first, then by item name
textes.Relie chaque plat à son véhicule pour en: Link each item to its vehicle to show its name. Two conditions true at the same time: the item is vegetarian, recorded as 1, and its category is exactly “Main”.
textes.Quels jours a-t-il plu pendant une sorti: On which days did it rain during a stop?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. A stop is a vehicle set up for the day at a location; several vehicles can be out on the same day. During each stop, the team records the weather: sun, clouds or rain. Octave, the founder, is thinking about buying canopy tents to shelter customers. He wants the list of days in the fortnight when at least one vehicle served in the rain, each day only once.
textes.la date de la sortie (une ligne par jour: the date of the stop (one row per day, without duplicates)
textes.Plusieurs véhicules peuvent sortir le mê: Several vehicles can be out on the same day.
textes.Une seule condition sur la météo, puis n: A single condition on the weather, then show only the date. Several vehicles out in the rain on the same day would give the same date several times: ask to show each row only once.
textes.Quelles ventes n’ont pas d’heure de remi: Which sales have no handover time?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each sale at the counter has an order time and a time it was handed to the customer. On the tablet, the crew member taps “Handed over” when giving the order, but sometimes forgets: the handover time cell then stays empty. Léonie, who runs the till, wants to find these sales, with their day, to remind the teams involved of the rule.
textes.les ventes dont l’heure de remise est vi: the sales whose handover time is empty (NULL)
textes.Relie chaque vente à sa sortie pour en c: Link each sale to its stop to know its date. A forgotten time leaves the cell empty, and you can’t compare an empty cell with an equals sign: there’s a separate way to ask for it.
textes.Combien les titres-restaurant ont-ils ra: How much did the meal vouchers bring in?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Customers pay by bank card, in cash or with a meal voucher. At the end of the fortnight, Octave, the founder, sends the meal vouchers received to the company that pays them back. To fill in the slip, he needs the number of sales paid that way and their total amount.
textes.le nombre de ventes payées en titre-rest: the number of sales paid with a meal voucher
textes.la somme de leurs montants, en euros: the sum of their amounts, in euros
textes.les ventes dont le mode de paiement est: the sales whose payment method is “Meal voucher”
textes.Garde les ventes payées en titre-restaur: Keep the sales paid with a meal voucher, then calculate two results side by side: their number, and the sum of their amounts.
textes.Quels noms de plats sont trop longs pour: Which item names are too long for the receipt?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each receipt shows the name of the items ordered. The new receipt printer cuts these names off after 20 characters. Prune, the head chef, wants to spot the items whose name goes over that limit, with its length, to find them a shorter name.
textes.les plats dont le nom compte plus de 20: the items whose name has more than 20 characters (20 not included)
textes.Une fonction donne le nombre de caractèr: A function gives the number of characters in a text. Use it twice: to keep the names longer than 20 characters, and to show their length.
textes.Quels clients ont presque rempli leur ca: Which customers have almost filled their card?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Its regulars have a stamp loyalty card: each visit with the card adds a stamp, and at the 10th, an item is free. Léonie, who manages these cards, wants to tell the customers who are at most two stamps away, meaning those who have at least 8, to get them back before the end of the month.
textes.les clients qui ont au moins 8 tampons: the customers with at least 8 stamps
textes.par nombre de tampons, du plus grand au: by number of stamps, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Une seule condition sur le nombre de tam: A single condition on the number of stamps: “at least 8” includes 8. Then sort from largest to smallest, then by last name and first name to break ties.
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. A sale groups all the items of one order at the counter, and its amount adds up their prices. Prune, the head chef, is thinking about launching a deal for groups of coworkers. To see what they order, and on which days, she first wants to find the 5 sales with the highest amount.
textes.seulement les 5 premières ventes de ce t: only the first 5 sales of this sort
textes.par montant, du plus élevé au plus bas,: by amount, highest first, then by sale ID
textes.Relie chaque vente à sa sortie pour en a: Link each sale to its stop to show its date. Sort from the biggest amount to the smallest, break ties with the ID, then keep the first 5 rows.
textes.Quels clients ont créé leur carte en 202: Which customers created their card in 2024?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Its loyalty card was launched in 2024, and the creation date of each card is known. Léonie, who handles it, wants to give an embroidered tote bag to the first people who signed up: the customers whose card was created in 2024.
textes.la date de création de sa carte: the date their card was created
textes.les cartes créées en 2024, du 1er janvie: the cards created in 2024, from January 1 to December 31
textes.L’année est au début de la date. Tu peux: The year is at the start of the date. You can extract it with a date function and compare it with “2024”, or keep the dates between the first and last day of 2024.
textes.Quels plats ont manqué avant midi ?: Which items ran out before noon?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. When an item runs out during a stop, the team records a stockout, with its time. Nolwenn, who manages stock, loads the vehicles before each stop. A stockout before noon means she loaded far too little: she wants to review those loads first.
textes.le nom du plat épuisé: the name of the item that ran out
textes.les ruptures survenues avant midi, c’est: the stockouts that happened before noon, meaning before 12:00
textes.Relie chaque rupture à son plat et à sa: Link each stockout to its item and its stop. Times are written as text, hours then minutes: they compare directly with “12:00”.
textes.Combien de sorties chaque emplacement a-: How many stops has each location hosted?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each stop on the schedule sets a vehicle up at a location for a day; it’s done, cancelled or still planned. Killian, who schedules the stops, is preparing the November schedule. He wants to know how many stops actually took place at each location, including those where no vehicle has served yet.
textes.son nombre de sorties effectuées, 0 s’il: its number of stops done, 0 if it has none
textes.tous les emplacements, y compris ceux qu: every location, including those with no stop done
textes.par nombre de sorties, du plus grand au: by number of stops, largest first, then by location name
textes.Les sorties annulées ou prévues ne compt: Cancelled or planned stops don’t count.
textes.Pars de tous les emplacements. Si tu éca: Start from every location. If you leave out the stops not done afterwards, the locations without a stop disappear: put that condition where you link the stops, then count them.
textes.Combien de temps attend-on à chaque véhi: How long do people wait at each vehicle?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each sale has its order time, and its handover time when the crew member remembered to record it. Prune, the head chef, is reorganizing the work on board the three vehicles. To know where customers wait the longest, she compares, vehicle by vehicle, the average waiting time between the order and the handover.
textes.son temps d’attente moyen, en minutes, a: its average waiting time, in minutes, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les ventes dont l’heure de rem: only the sales whose handover time is known
textes.par temps d’attente moyen, du plus long: by average waiting time, longest first
textes.Le temps d’attente d’une vente est son h: A sale’s waiting time is its handover time minus its order time, in minutes: from 12:05 to 12:17, it’s 12 minutes.
textes.Dans la base de l’app, une heure HH:MM e: In the app’s database, an HH:MM time is text: subtracting two times only gives the difference in hours (“12:17” minus “12:05” gives 0), without any error. With the “%s” format, strftime first turns each time into seconds.
textes.Le véhicule d’une vente est celui de sa: A sale’s vehicle is the one of its stop.
textes.Les heures sont du texte : une fonction: Times are text: a date function first has to turn them into seconds. That way, calculate each sale’s wait in minutes, then take the average per vehicle, the one of the stop.
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. A stop is a vehicle set up for the day at a location; it’s done, cancelled or planned, and only the stops that are done have sales. At each stop done, the team records the weather: sun, clouds or rain. Octave, the founder, wonders whether it’s worth going out on rainy days. For each kind of weather, he compares the number of stops done, the number of sales and the revenue.
textes.le nombre de sorties effectuées sous cet: the number of stops done in this weather
textes.le nombre de ventes de ces sorties: the number of sales of these stops
textes.leur chiffre d’affaires : la somme des m: their revenue: the sum of the amounts of these sales, in euros
textes.seulement les sorties effectuées: only the stops that are done
textes.Une sortie compte une seule fois, quel q: A stop counts only once, whatever its number of sales.
textes.Relie les sorties effectuées à leurs ven: Link the stops done to their sales, then make one group per kind of weather. Each stop comes back once per sale: for the stops, count each one only once.
textes.À quels moments de la journée les client: At what times of day do customers order?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Its vehicles serve from the first coffee of the morning until the evening, and each sale has its order time. Killian, who schedules the stops, wants to adjust the opening hours. He splits the day into four times of day; for each one, he wants the number of sales and what they bring in, all vehicles and all locations combined.
textes.le moment de la journée, selon l’heure d: the time of day, based on the order time: “Morning” before 11:00, “Midday” from 11:00 to 14:59, “Afternoon” from 15:00 to 17:59, “Evening” from 18:00
textes.le nombre de ventes de ce moment: the number of sales at this time of day
textes.leur chiffre d’affaires : la somme de le: their revenue: the sum of their amounts, in euros
textes.Range chaque heure de commande dans son: File each order time into its time of day, testing the cut-off times in order: the first true condition wins. Then make one group per time of day to count and add up.
textes.Quels clients sont venus au moins cinq f: Which customers came at least five times?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. A customer who shows their loyalty card at the counter is recorded on the sale; other customers stay anonymous. Léonie, who manages the loyalty cards, is having “Regular” badges made. She wants to give them to the customers who showed their card on at least 5 sales during the fortnight.
textes.seulement les clients qui ont au moins 5: only the customers with at least 5 sales
textes.Compte les ventes de chaque client. La c: Count each customer’s sales. The condition applies to that number: it applies once the counting is done, not row by row.
textes.Quels plats n’ont jamais été vendus ?: Which items have never been sold?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each vehicle has its own menu, and two vehicles can offer an item with the same name. Each sale lists the items ordered, but some items on the menu found no buyer. Nolwenn, who manages stock, is sorting out her supplier orders. She’s looking for the items never sold during the fortnight, so she stops buying their ingredients.
textes.seulement les plats qui n’apparaissent d: only the items that don’t appear in any sale
textes.par nom du véhicule, puis par nom du pla: by vehicle name, then by item name
textes.Chaque véhicule a sa propre carte : deux: Each vehicle has its own menu: two items from different vehicles can have the same name.
textes.Associe à chaque plat les lignes de vent: Match each item with the sale rows where it appears, also keeping the items that have none, and keep only those. Reason on the item itself, not on its name.
textes.Combien de portions de chaque plat ont é: How many portions of each item were sold?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each sale lists its items, with the number of portions of each: one sale can include three coffees. Nolwenn, who manages stock, is preparing the loads for the next fortnight. To take the right quantities, she wants to know how many portions of each item went during the one that just ended, vehicle by vehicle.
textes.le nom du plat (une ligne par plat de ch: the item’s name (one row per item of each vehicle)
textes.son nombre de portions vendues : la somm: its number of portions sold: the sum of the quantities
textes.seulement les plats vendus au moins une: only the items sold at least once
textes.par nom du véhicule, puis par nombre de: by vehicle name, then by number of portions, largest first, then by item name
textes.Une vente peut compter plusieurs portion: A sale can include several portions of the same item: that’s its quantity.
textes.Relie chaque ligne de vente à son plat,: Link each sale row to its item, then the item to its vehicle. Make one group per vehicle and per item, then add up the portions rather than counting the rows.
textes.Quels plats coûtent plus cher que le pri: Which items cost more than the menu’s average price?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. The three vehicles’ menus go from the €2 drink to the €12.50 burger. Prune, the head chef, is reviewing her prices before winter. She starts with the items that cost more than the average price of the whole menu, the three vehicles together, sides, desserts and drinks included.
textes.seulement les plats dont le prix dépasse: only the items whose price is strictly above the average price of all items
textes.par prix, du plus élevé au plus bas, pui: by price, highest first, then by item name
textes.Le prix moyen se calcule sur tous les pl: The average price is calculated over all the items of the three vehicles, sides, desserts and drinks included.
textes.Calcule d’abord le prix moyen de tous le: First calculate the average price of all the items, in a separate query, then compare each item’s price with that result.
textes.Combien chaque client a-t-il dépensé pen: How much did each customer spend during the fortnight?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Eighteen customers have a loyalty card, but not all of them came during the fortnight. Léonie, who manages these cards, is preparing the fortnight review. She wants to know how much each cardholder spent, including those who didn’t come, with 0, to follow up with them.
textes.son total : la somme des montants de ses: their total: the sum of their sale amounts, in euros, 0 if they have none
textes.tous les clients, y compris ceux qui n’o: every customer, including those with no sales
textes.par total, du plus élevé au plus bas, pu: by total, highest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Pars de tous les clients, même sans vent: Start from every customer, even without a sale, then add up their amounts. Without any sale, the sum gives an empty cell: a function lets you replace it with 0.
textes.Quel jour de la semaine rapporte le plus: Which day of the week brings in the most?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. The fortnight from October 6 to 19, 2025 covers two full weeks, from Monday to Sunday. Killian, who schedules the stops, is looking for the best day to close and have the vehicles serviced. He compares the revenue of each day of the week, with the two Mondays counting together, and the same for each day.
textes.le jour de la semaine, en toutes lettres: the day of the week, written out in full: “Monday”, “Tuesday”, “Wednesday”, “Thursday”, “Friday”, “Saturday” or “Sunday”
textes.le chiffre d’affaires de ce jour : la so: this day’s revenue: the sum of its sale amounts, in euros
textes.Avec le format « %w », strftime donne le: With the “%w” format, strftime gives the day of the week as text: “0” for Sunday, “1” for Monday, and so on up to “6” for Saturday.
textes.Les ventes des deux lundis comptent ense: The sales of the two Mondays count together, and the same for each day.
textes.Le jour d’une vente est celui de sa sort: A sale’s day is the day of its stop.
textes.Relie chaque vente à sa sortie pour en c: Link each sale to its stop to know its date. A date function gives the number of the day of the week, as text: turn it into a name, then make one group per day.
textes.Quel est le classement des emplacements: How do the locations rank by revenue?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Its vehicles set up at nine locations, from the Station Forecourt to the Chestnut Festival, and some haven’t seen any sales yet. Octave, the founder, is renegotiating his locations for next year. He ranks them by the revenue the vehicles made there, including those where nothing has been sold yet.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the sale amounts of its stops, in euros, 0 if it has none
textes.tous les emplacements, y compris ceux qu: every location, including those with no sales
textes.par rang, puis par nom de l’emplacement: by rank, then by location name
textes.Pars de tous les emplacements et descend: Start from every location and go down to the sales through the stops, keeping those that have nothing. Add up the amounts, with 0 when there’s nothing, then rank these totals: ties share their rank.
textes.Combien de portions Le Carbu vend-il, ma: How many portions does Le Carbu sell, morning after morning?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Le Carbu, the cargo trike, serves coffee and sweets several mornings a week on the Station Forecourt, and each sale lists its portions. To adjust its load, Nolwenn, who manages stock, tracks the portions sold morning after morning, and the change from the previous morning.
textes.le nombre de portions de la sortie précé: the number of portions of the previous stop, an empty cell (NULL) for the first one
textes.l’écart : les portions de la sortie moin: the change: the stop’s portions minus the previous one’s, an empty cell (NULL) for the first one
textes.seulement les sorties effectuées du véhi: only the stops done by the vehicle “Le Carbu” at the location “Station Forecourt”
textes.La sortie précédente est la sortie effec: The previous stop is Le Carbu’s stop done at the Station Forecourt that comes just before, by date.
textes.Additionne d’abord les portions de chaqu: First add up the portions of each stop done by Le Carbu at the station. Sort these stops by date, then read for each one the value from the row just before: a function lets you do that.
textes.Comment le chiffre d’affaires de chaque: How does each vehicle’s revenue add up?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each of the three vehicles makes its own stops and takes in its own sales. Léonie, who runs the till, is preparing her fortnight review. She follows each vehicle separately, day after day: what it took in that day, and the total since its first stop, to see which one takes off and when.
textes.la date (une ligne par véhicule et par j: the date (one row per vehicle and per day it sold)
textes.son chiffre d’affaires ce jour-là : la s: its revenue that day: the sum of its sale amounts, in euros
textes.son cumul : la somme de ses chiffres d’a: its running total: the sum of its revenue for that day and the days before
textes.par nom du véhicule, puis par date: by vehicle name, then by date
textes.Le cumul de chaque véhicule ne compte qu: Each vehicle’s running total only counts its own sales: it starts again from zero from one vehicle to the next.
textes.Le jour d’une vente est la date de sa so: A sale’s day is the date of its stop.
textes.Calcule d’abord ce que chaque véhicule e: First calculate what each vehicle takes in each day. Then add up these amounts as you go, in date order, with the total starting again from zero for each vehicle.
textes.Quelles ventes ont fait attendre bien pl: Which sales kept people waiting much longer than usual?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. A customer’s wait goes from their order to the handover of their items, when the handover time was recorded, and each vehicle has its own pace. Prune, the head chef, wants to talk about abnormal waits with each team. For her, a wait is abnormal when it’s more than 5 minutes above the vehicle’s average wait.
textes.l’attente moyenne du véhicule, en minute: the vehicle’s average wait, in minutes, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les ventes dont l’attente dépa: only the sales whose wait is more than 5 minutes above their vehicle’s average wait
textes.par nom du véhicule, puis par attente, d: by vehicle name, then by wait, longest first, then by sale ID
textes.L’attente est l’heure de remise moins l’: The wait is the handover time minus the order time, in minutes. An HH:MM time is text: subtracting two times only gives the difference in hours, without any error; strftime’s “%s” format first turns them into seconds.
textes.Les ventes sans heure de remise ne compt: Sales without a handover time count neither in the average nor in the result.
textes.Compare l’attente à la moyenne avant de: Compare the wait with the average before rounding it.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule l’attent: Work in two steps: calculate each sale’s wait in minutes, then each vehicle’s average wait. Finally, compare each sale with its vehicle’s average, plus 5.
textes.Quels véhicules se sont retrouvés au mêm: Which vehicles ended up in the same place at the same time?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each stop sets a vehicle up at a location, on a given day, from its opening time to its closing time. Killian, who schedules the stops, wants to keep two vehicles from competing with each other. He’s looking for the times when two vehicles served at the same location, on the same day, with overlapping hours; one in the morning and the other in the evening isn’t an overlap.
textes.le nom du premier véhicule de la paire: the name of the first vehicle of the pair
textes.les paires de sorties effectuées au même: the pairs of stops done at the same location and on the same date whose hours overlap: each one opens before the other closes
textes.chaque paire une seule fois : le premier: each pair only once: the first vehicle is the one whose name comes first in alphabetical order
textes.par date, puis par nom de l’emplacement,: by date, then by location name, then by first vehicle’s name, then by second’s name
textes.Le même jour, deux sorties au même endro: On the same day, two stops in the same place, one in the morning and the other in the evening, don’t overlap.
textes.Associe les sorties entre elles : même e: Match the stops with each other: same location, same date. Two time slots overlap when each starts before the other ends. To keep each pair only once, impose an order between the two names.
textes.Quels clients ont goûté aux trois véhicu: Which customers have tried all three vehicles?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike, La Bielle, La Soupape and Le Carbu. A loyalty cardholder can buy from each of them, and their card is recorded on the sale. Léonie, who manages the cards, is launching a “Full Tour” badge. She wants to give it to the customers who bought at least once from each of the three vehicles during the fortnight.
textes.seulement les clients qui ont au moins u: only the customers with at least one sale at each of the fleet’s vehicles
textes.Retourne la question : un client convien: Turn the question around: a customer fits if there’s no vehicle where they bought nothing. You can also count each customer’s different vehicles and compare with the number of vehicles in the fleet.
textes.Où les espèces pèsent-elles plus que dan: Where does cash weigh more than across the whole fleet?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Its vehicles set up at locations of various types (station, market, offices, campus, park or festival), and customers pay there by card, in cash or with a meal voucher. Octave, the founder, is thinking about no longer accepting cash, which requires a cash float. Before deciding, he’s looking, for each vehicle and each location type, for where it weighs more than across the whole fleet.
textes.la part des espèces dans le chiffre d’af: the share of cash in this vehicle’s revenue at this location type, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.la même part, pour toute la flotte, en p: the same share, for the whole fleet, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.une ligne par véhicule et par type d’emp: one row per vehicle and per location type where it sold
textes.seulement les lignes dont la part des es: only the rows whose cash share is strictly above the whole fleet’s
textes.La part des espèces est le montant payé: The cash share is the amount paid in cash divided by the revenue, multiplied by 100.
textes.Le véhicule et l’emplacement d’une vente: A sale’s vehicle and location are those of its stop.
Compare the shares before rounding them.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule la part: Work in two steps: calculate the cash share for each vehicle and location type, adding up only the amounts paid in cash, then the same share for the whole fleet. Finally, compare each row with the fleet’s.
textes.Quel est le plat le plus vendu de chaque: What is each vehicle’s best-selling item?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each vehicle has its own menu, desserts and drinks included, and each sale lists its portions. Prune, the head chef, wants to feature each vehicle’s star item on its new chalkboard: the one it sold the most portions of. She keeps only one per vehicle; if tied, the one whose name comes first in alphabetical order.
textes.le nom de son plat le plus vendu: the name of its best-selling item
textes.un seul plat par véhicule, pris sur tout: a single item per vehicle, taken from its whole menu, drinks and desserts included: the one with the most portions sold; if tied, the one whose name comes first in alphabetical order
Add up the portions of each item. Then number each vehicle’s items from best-selling to least-selling, with the name breaking ties, and keep number 1.
textes.Combien de clients sont passés après cha: How many customers came after each stockout?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. When an item runs out during a stop, it’s called a stockout: it isn’t sold anymore until the end of that stop. Nolwenn, who manages stock, is measuring what these stockouts cost. For each one, she counts the sales made during the same stop after the stockout time: that many customers who couldn’t choose that item.
textes.le nombre de ventes de la même sortie co: the number of sales of the same stop ordered after that time, 0 if there are none
textes.toutes les ruptures, y compris celles qu: every stockout, including those followed by no sales
textes.par nombre de ventes, du plus grand au p: by number of sales, largest first, then by date, then by stockout time
textes.Pars des ruptures et associe-leur les ve: Start from the stockouts and match them with the sales of the same stop ordered later, keeping the stockouts with no sale afterwards. The condition on the times goes where you link the sales.
textes.Combien chaque véhicule gagne-t-il, rede: How much does each vehicle make, after paying fees?
textes.Popote & Pistons est une petite entrepri: Popote & Pistons is a small street food business: two food trucks and a cargo trike. Each location charges a fee, once per stop done, whatever the number of sales: up to €60 for the Chestnut Festival. Cancelled or planned stops cost nothing. Octave, the founder, is preparing the fortnight review. For each vehicle, he wants its revenue, its total fees and what’s left once these fees are deducted.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of its sale amounts, in euros
textes.le total de ses redevances : la somme de: its total fees: the sum of the fees of its stops done, in euros
textes.ce qui reste : le chiffre d’affaires moi: what’s left: the revenue minus the fees
textes.La redevance d’un emplacement est payée: A location’s fee is paid once per stop done, whatever the number of sales.
textes.Les sorties annulées ou prévues ne coûte: Cancelled or planned stops cost nothing.
textes.Calcule le chiffre d’affaires et les red: Calculate the revenue and the fees separately, each per vehicle, before bringing them together: linking everything at once, each fee would be counted once per sale.
